models_evaluated: Adapted clinical decision support system with ICU-tailored drug-drug interaction alerts

links.outcome: Administered high-risk drug combinations per 1000 drug administrations per patient
links.effect: Mean 26·2 (SD 53·4) intervention vs 35·6 (65·0) control; 12% decrease (95% CI 5-18%; p=0·0008) after adjustment for clustering and prognostic factors.
links.quote: Tailoring potential DDI alerts to the ICU led to a 12% decrease (95% CI 5-18%; p=0·0008) in the number of administered high-risk drug combinations per 1000 drug administrations per patient, after adjusting for clustering and prognostic factors.

unlisted_practices: Tailoring drug-drug interaction alerts to a specific care setting (ICU) so that only clinically relevant high-risk alerts are shown, reducing low-yield alerts
